```{r}
save_path_data <- "C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Intra_day_instrumnet_motivation/ENTSOE/day_ahead/outputs"
setwd(save_path_data)
price_indispo_merge <- read_parquet("price_indispo_merge.parquet")
price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>%
  fill(spot_gas, .direction = "up")
price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge[complete.cases(price_indispo_merge),]

price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge[!rowSums(sapply(price_indispo_merge, is.infinite)), ]

#get monthly avg of unavailabilities
capacity_fields <- c("Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_diff", "Tot_Planned_Unavailability_diff",
                     "Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_diff2","Tot_Planned_Unavailability_diff2", "gen_tot",
                     "Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability", "Tot_Planned_Unavailability",
             "renewable_forecast", "spot_gas", "unpredicted_renewables", "intraday_update_renewables",
             "Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_sadj", "Tot_Planned_Unavailability_sadj")

price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000)) %>% 
  group_by(year, month) %>% 
  mutate(Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_avg = mean(Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability ,na.rm = TRUE),
          Tot_Planned_Unavailability_avg = mean(Tot_Planned_Unavailability ,na.rm = TRUE),
         unpredicted_renewables_sq = unpredicted_renewables^2,)

```

On suggère deux hypothèses, soit différence en niveau sur longue période, soit différence immédiate sur des conditions quasi similaires lors de l'activation d'une indispo à deux créneaux proches.

Attention le fait d'avoir pris des heures arrondies à l'heure plien la plus proche peut fausser
les résultats.

On essaye d'abord en différence 




```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_diff <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_diff + Tot_Planned_Unavailability_diff+ gen_tot+
    renewable_forecast,
  data= price_indispo_merge)


m_diff_plus <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_diff + Tot_Planned_Unavailability_diff+ gen_tot+
    renewable_forecast + spot_gas + unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables + 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month),
  data= price_indispo_merge)

m_diff_final <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_diff + Tot_Planned_Unavailability_diff+ gen_tot+
    Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability+Tot_Planned_Unavailability+
    renewable_forecast + spot_gas + unpredicted_renewables + unpredicted_renewables_sq + intraday_update_renewables + 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month),
  data= price_indispo_merge)


```



```{r, results = 'asis'}

reg_table <- stargazer( m_diff, m_diff_plus, m_diff_final, 
    type = "html",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Time FE", "+ Controls"),
    keep = c("Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_diff", "Tot_Planned_Unavailability_diff", "gen_tot",
             "renewable_forecast", "spot_gas", "unpredicted_renewables","unpredicted_renewables_sq", "intraday_update_renewables",
             "Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability", "Tot_Planned_Unavailability")
)
 
```

On le fait maintenant en niveau


```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_log <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability + Tot_Planned_Unavailability + gen_tot+
    renewable_forecast,
  data= price_indispo_merge)


m_log_plus <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability + Tot_Planned_Unavailability + gen_tot+
    renewable_forecast + spot_gas + unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables + 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month),
  data= price_indispo_merge)

m_log_final <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability + Tot_Planned_Unavailability + gen_tot+
    #Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_avg +Tot_Planned_Unavailability_avg +
    renewable_forecast + spot_gas + unpredicted_renewables + unpredicted_renewables_sq + intraday_update_renewables + 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month),
  data= price_indispo_merge)


```



```{r, results = 'asis'}

reg_table <- stargazer( m_log, m_log_plus, m_log_final, 
    type = "html",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Time FE", "+ Controls"),
    keep = c("Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_diff", "Tot_Planned_Unavailability_diff", "gen_tot",
             "renewable_forecast", "spot_gas", "unpredicted_renewables","unpredicted_renewables_sq", "intraday_update_renewables", "Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability", "Tot_Planned_Unavailability",
             "Tot_Unplanned_Unavailability_avg", "Tot_Planned_Unavailability_avg")
)
 
```
